children: Equity benchmarks gained strength after a mixed performance in the previous two sessions, with the Nifty 50 advancing 0.29 percent. However, market breadth remained weak, with about 1,719 shares declining against 1,564 advancing shares on the NSE. The market may extend its uptrend while remaining range-bound. Here are some short-term trading ideas to consider:
Jigar S Patel, Senior Manager - Equity Research at Anand Rathi
Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corporation | CMP: Rs 1,365.9

Deepak Fertilisers has witnessed a correction of approximately 24.5 percent from its recent top and is currently taking support near the 38.2 percent Fibonacci retracement level of the previous upmove. Importantly, this Fibonacci support zone is also aligning with the weekly flat cloud, creating a confluence of technical support and making the current zone significant from a medium-term perspective.

Further strengthening the setup, the daily RSI has formed a hidden bullish divergence, indicating improving underlying momentum despite the recent price correction. The combination of Fibonacci support, weekly cloud support, and hidden bullish divergence suggests that the stock may be approaching an important reversal or accumulation zone. Traders may consider entering long positions in the Rs 1,370-1,340 zone, with target of Rs 1,555.

Jubilant Foodworks has started sustaining above its 45-week moving average (WMA), indicating improving price structure and a potential shift in medium-term momentum. Recently, the stock has also formed a bullish divergence on the daily chart, suggesting that underlying momentum is improving despite the recent price action.

The combination of sustained price action above the 45 WMA and bullish divergence on the daily RSI strengthens the positive technical setup. Going forward, continued sustainability above the 45 WMA would be important to maintain the bullish bias and support further upside. Overall, the current technical structure indicates that the uptrend in Jubilant Foodworks is likely to continue. Traders may consider entering long positions in the zone Rs 488-475.
HDFC Life Insurance Company | CMP: Rs 559.4

Over the last 4–5 months, HDFC Life Insurance Company has formed four distinct bottoms, indicating the emergence of a strong base formation around the lower levels. Importantly, multiple bullish divergences on the daily RSI have been observed during these bottom formations, suggesting improving underlying momentum despite the repeated weakness in price.

Adding further strength to the technical setup, the stock has recently witnessed a breakout above the falling trendline, indicating a possible change in the prevailing short-term trend. The combination of repeated bottom formation, multiple bullish RSI divergences, and falling trendline violation strengthens the overall technical structure. Going forward, sustained price action above the broken trendline could attract fresh buying interest and support further upside. Traders may consider entering long positions in the Rs 560-550 zone.
Jay Thakkar, Vice President & Head of Derivatives and Quant Research at ICICI Securities

ITC has formed a base near Rs 260 level and with that it has now started to form higher highs and higher lows which is a positive sign. It has also witnessed some reduction in the open interest indicating short covering and as it approaches the monthly expiry some further short covering cannot be ruled out.

As per the options data, Rs 260 and Rs 265 strikes have witnessed significant Put additions whereas Rs 270 strike has the highest Call base and beyond that there is a higher chance of short covering. The maximum pain is at Rs 265 and the stock is trading well above it Rs 265 hence that too is a positive. Buy ITC Futures in the range of Rs 265-268.

Lupin has been an underperformer in the Nifty Pharma Index. Overall so far as the index has been inching higher whereas Lupin has been correcting, however, now it seems to have form a short-term base. There have been short additions and as we approach the monthly expiry, a short-term bounce due to short covering is expected.

As per the options data, it has witnessed significant Put additions from Rs 2,000 to Rs 2,100 strikes, particularly Rs 2,100 strike now has the highest Put base and that is an important support and until that is not broken the overall bias remains positive. On the upside, Rs 2,200 strike has the highest Call base which is likely to be tested. The maximum pain is at Rs 2,120 and the stock has managed to close above the same. Buy Lupin Futures in the range of Rs 2,110-2,130.
Muthoot Finance has formed a short term base near Rs 2,800 and with that there has been some reduction in the open interest as well indicating short covering as well.

As per the options data, there has been Put additions near Rs 2,800 level which will act as a short term support whereas Rs 2,900 strike has the immediate Call base above which it is likely to witness further short covering. The maximum pain is at Rs 2,120 and the stock has closed above the same which is a positive sign. Buy Muthoot Finance Futures in the range of Rs 2,850 – 2,870.
Somil Mehta, Head of Retail Research at Mirae Asset ShareKhan

Sun Pharma has been going through a corrective phase lately, moving down within a downward-sloping channel — this could be shaping into a flag pattern. Recently, it has bounced back from its 40-week EMA and the lower end of the channel, which adds a positive sign.

Overall, the chart structure suggests that the A-B-C decline is now complete. Even in a conservative scenario, the stock looks set for a pullback of the recent fall, which could take it up toward the Rs 1,950–2,000 zone.
This bullish view stays valid as long as the stock holds above the 40-week EMA on a closing basis, crrently placed at Rs 1,825. A close below this level would put the bullish setup at risk.
Sapphire Foods continues to form higher highs and higher lows on both the daily and weekly charts and is trading above its key daily and weekly moving averages — a sign the broader uptrend is intact.

The recent short-term correction found support around the 40-day EMA, after which the stock bounced back sharply. It has since given a bullish crossover, and on Monday, it broke above both the swing high and the 20-day moving average.
Taken together, this chart setup suggests the short-term correction is now over, and the stock looks poised to move higher toward the Rs 250–259 zone in the coming sessions.

Samvardhana Motherson International remains in a solid uptrend, holding above its 40-day EMA for several months now. Each time it dipped to this average and bounced back, it marked the end of a short-term correction and led to fresh highs.

Recently, the stock briefly slipped below the 40-day EMA for a day, but it has since reclaimed this level and is now trading comfortably above it — a reassuring sign. Adding to this, the daily momentum indicator gave a bullish crossover on Monday, strengthening the case for the uptrend to resume.
Overall, the chart setup points to further upside, with the stock likely to move toward the Rs 169.50–173 zone in the coming sessions.
